phases.name: The Unmasking
phases.say: (The hood falls back. There is no face, only a door.)

say.open: (It does not speak. It only counts you.)
say.death: (It steps aside, as if letting you pass for now.)

bestiary.lore: The thirteenth card, which is not an ending but a change. It walks the Barrows taking the count.
bestiary.weakness: Holy, heavily. Heal the one it Marks before the Last Breath lands.
bestiary.pattern: Every third turn it charges the Last Breath at the weakest and Marks them; it reaps a row and chills the least sane between. Unmasked at half, it goes for whoever is Marked.
